# Dart Nostr documentation

> Dart and Flutter SDK for the Nostr protocol. The documentation site is hosted
> at https://nostr.gwhyyy.com/.

Known routes:

- [Getting started](https://nostr.gwhyyy.com/docs/): package overview and orientation.
- [Installation](https://nostr.gwhyyy.com/docs/installation/): add dart_nostr to a Dart or Flutter project.
- [Quick start](https://nostr.gwhyyy.com/docs/quick-start/): connect, publish, and subscribe end to end.
- [Core concepts](https://nostr.gwhyyy.com/docs/must-know/): package structure and singleton model.
- [Usage guides](https://nostr.gwhyyy.com/docs/usage/keys-management/): keys, identity, relays and events, advanced topics.
- [NIP coverage](https://nostr.gwhyyy.com/docs/reference/nip-coverage/): per-NIP support status.
- [Accessors](https://nostr.gwhyyy.com/docs/reference/accessors/): `NostrNips` accessor reference.

The site's own sitemap is the canonical route list. This repository builds a
standalone preview copy under the `/nostr/` base path; that build is not
deployed.
